limits: Only Windows transaction mutation driver results are independently assessed here; full51 and authored compiler-security fixture conclusions belong to the other reviewer.
No installer, PowerShell, compiler, native API, mutation, or product test was executed during receiving. Archives were inspected in memory, never bulk extracted.

Child exit attribution is the immutable driver's recorded gate and aggregate terminal command, corroborated by raw complete JSON; there is no separate external per-child process monitor in this archive.

Original Windows lstat/reparse/direct-child admission is executed by the exact driver. Offline receiving verifies that gate unchanged plus reported roots, exact raw receipt Unicode, collector mappings and retained regular member bytes; it cannot re-lstat the now-ended Windows VM.

All native5 failures remain historical. The source, tests, recipes and assertions are unchanged; moving child fixtures to siblings removes one redundant38-character component. New all-green prerequisites establish the new acquisition route, not a proved cause for every earlier failure.
No independent filesystem/network containment, browser installation, Windows long-path general support, release/merge/owner acceptance or full work-order closure is claimed.

receiverPremiseCorrections.explanation: Receiver initially normalized CRLF once. Original raw CRLF is correctly expanded by Windows Path.write_text into CRCRLF. Final check requires the exact raw UTF-8 decode plus native newline transformation; raw bytes remain canonical.

Receiver initially required empty child stderr. Actual PS5.1 stderr is bounded CLIXML containing only module-preparation progress. Final checks parse every XML object and reject any non-progress or unexpected activity; no error output is discarded.
